_how_to_use: One file runs every studio's Marketing Hub (partners.pluultra.com/hub/<slug>/). 'studios' holds each studio's own links. 'tools' are the always-on portals; {upload} and {studioName} are filled in per studio. 'items' are dated promos/assets: they show only between start and end (inclusive, studio local time) and only for the listed studio slugs (or "all"). Remove or let an item expire to hide it.
